APK signing: v2 and v3 verified; existing pinned signing certificate retained.
Manifest inspected: launcher and service/provider classes retain their full source names;
update content authority is cc.huevia.updates.

Changes:
- Camera selection and un-downloaded viewer expose download actions.
- Camera JPG batches bypass preset/export processing and download exact originals.
- Camera selection no longer exposes preset application.
- Downloaded single-photo editing and batch preset/export remain available.
- Downloads retire queued browse/preview work, draining any in-flight protocol frame.
- JPEG, live original and NEF receiving use 256 KiB buffered disk output, flushed before fsync.
- PTP/IP streaming uses up to 256 KiB working buffers without buffering the full object.
- A bounded gallery queue can save previous originals while the next camera read proceeds.
- Batch tokens prevent late gallery callbacks from altering a later download batch.
- Release handling accepts fixed legacy/new install IDs and isolates latest-release queries.
- New installs safely ignore legacy-package responses from a server awaiting migration.

Scope:
Local build and synthetic host validation only. No Android device was attached during
this run. No real-camera throughput measurement or new native interaction certification.
No app installation, user-data migration, production database change, server deployment,
APK publication or QQ-console update was performed by this change.

Migration before online publication:
Apply online-library/database/012-huevia-package.sql and deploy corresponding server
code before uploading/publishing this APK. The new app and download page explicitly
query packageName=cc.huevia; older clients retain the legacy package's update stream.
Changing applicationId creates a separate Android app: preserve the old installation
until its photos/presets have been exported or otherwise intentionally migrated.
QQ Connect Android package registration must be updated to cc.huevia by its owner.
